We use three evaluation metrics, following . (1) Disambig-F1 (D-F1) measures the factual correctness of generated predictions. (2) ROUGE-L (R-L) measures the lexical overlap between long-form answers from references and predictions. (3) DR score is the geometric mean of two scores, which assesses the overall performance.
